BUSINESS CLUB

RMIT Vietnam Business Club – SGS (BC), established in 2004, is one of the oldest academic clubs founded at RMIT. Our vision is to Nurture Future Business Leaders, achieved by sharpening club members’ business acumen and strengthening leadership.

  • Growth mindset
  • Leadership
  • Initiative
  • Critical thinking
  • Effective communication
